datasets.name: Account_data
datasets.sql:
select
a.id,a.acc_no,a.name,a.val_acc,c.inn,ac.pok_ostat,ac.ostat

account a,customers c,archost ac

(a.kli_ID=c.id)and(a.id=ac.acc_id)and(ac.datdate=sbop.get_date)

datasets.name: Hox102_out
datasets.sql:
select
  h.*,a.acc_no,a.name,v.val_name,h.amount/k.ostat as lamount
from
  hox102_out h,account a,avalute v,operkurs k
where
  h.acc_id = a.id and
  v.valute=a.val_acc and
 (transdate>=:BeginDate and
  transdate<=:EndDate)AND
 ((a.val_acc=k.val_kod)and(k.dat=h.transdate)) 
 order by
  h.id,h.status desc

from
   HoxMessage_in h,avalute v,bankm b

   (trans_date>=:BeginDate and trans_date<=:EndDate)

datasets.name: ToSend
datasets.sql:
select
                   h.*,
                   a.acc_no,
                   v.val_name              
from
	   hox102_out h,
	   account a,
	   avalute v
where
                   h.acc_id = a.id and
                   v.valute=h.val_acc and
                  (transdate>=:BeginDate and
                   transdate<=:EndDate)and
                   (h.send=1)and
                  (h.status=1)

datasets.name: NoSend
datasets.sql:
select
                   h.*,
                   a.acc_no,
                   v.val_name
from
	           hox102_out h,
                   account a,
           	   avalute v
where
                   h.acc_id = a.id and
                   v.valute=h.val_acc and
                  (transdate>=:BeginDate and
                   transdate<=:EndDate)and
                   ((h.send is null)or(h.send=0))and
                  (h.status=1)and (hoxpack.CheckForFile(h.id,1) =1)

datasets.name: HOXAccount
datasets.sql:
select
    v.val_name,a.acc_no as hox
from
    hoxsw_account h,avalute v, account a 
where
    (h.valute=v.valute) and(h.hox_id=a.id)

datasets.name: SWAccount
datasets.sql:

    v.val_name,a.acc_no as sw
from
    hoxsw_account h,avalute v, account a 
where
    (h.valute=v.valute) and(h.swift_id=a.id)
